map.解读血清IgG4水平在IgG4相关疾病(IgG4-RD)诊断及器官受累评估中的意: Interpret serum IgG4 in the diagnosis of IgG4-related disease (IgG4-RD) and organ involvement assessment
map.：发热、抗核抗体高滴度、PR3/MPO-ANCA阳性等(-5至-10分): : fever, high-titer ANA, PR3/MPO-ANCA positive, etc (-5 to -10)
map.不支持IgG4-RD(但15-20%患者可正常): Not suggestive of IgG4-RD (but 15-20% of patients are normal)
map.提示：血清IgG4升高虽是IgG4-RD的重要标志，但并非特异性。IgG4升高也: Note: elevated serum IgG4 is an important but non-specific marker of IgG4-RD. IgG4 also rises in pancreatic/cholangiocarcinoma (must differentiate), allergic disease, parasitic infection, Castleman disease, etc. Histopathology (storiform fibrosis + obliterative phlebitis + IgG4+ plasma cells) is the gold standard. IgG4-RD responds excellently to glucocorticoids, most patients improve markedly within 2-4 weeks. Rituximab for refractory/relapsing cases. IgG4/IgG ratio >10% also has diagnostic value. For clinical reference only.
map.IgG4 2800 mg/dL（>135）、IgG 1600 → 比值 175%: IgG4 2800 mg/dL (>135), IgG 1600 → ratio 175%>10%; with pancreatic+salivary+retroperitoneal involvement → consistent with IgG4-RD, needs steroid induction.
map.IgG4 320、比值 12% 单一淋巴结 → 临界，结合病理（席纹状纤维化/闭: IgG4 320, ratio 12% single lymph node → borderline, confirm with pathology (storiform fibrosis/obliterative phlebitis).
map.典型器官表现+血清 IgG4 升高+病理（IgG4+浆细胞/席纹）+激素敏感综合: Typical organ findings + elevated serum IgG4 + pathology (IgG4+ plasma cells/storiform) + steroid sensitivity; ratio >10% supports but alone does not confirm.
map.与淋巴瘤、Castleman、感染、ANCA 相关病鉴别；激素反应好但易复发。: Differentiate from lymphoma, Castleman, infection, ANCA-related disease; good steroid response but prone to relapse.
